coverage_override.reason: The standard/alternative Xyz material method is one summon mechanic, followed by two separately activatable HOPT effects.

effects.printed_clause: 2 Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster monsters. You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a Rank 4 "Arckcestial" monster (transfer its materials to this card).
effects.lua_implementation: The Xyz procedure accepts two Level 6 LIGHT Spellcasters or overlays this card on one face-up Rank 4 Arckcestial Xyz Monster, transferring its materials through the engine procedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Official alternative Xyz procedures overlay on a filtered Rank 4 archetype Xyz Monster and transfer its materials.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Special Summoned: You can attach 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your GY or face-up banishment to this card as material.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed Special Summon trigger chooses a Necrovalley-legal Arckcestial monster from the GY or face-up banishment and overlays it onto this card under the first HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz support selects an eligible card and attaches it with Duel.Overlay while respecting zone/public-state requirements.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your GY in Defense Position, then discard 1 card.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main-Phase Quick Effect removes one overlay as cost and now requires both a summonable GY Arckcestial plus an actually discardable hand card at activation; it summons in Defense, then performs the mandatory discard.

official_references.matched_structure: Official 'Special Summon, then send 1 card from your hand' handling requires the mandatory hand movement in its activation-legality check before summoning from the GY.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the old target check allowed activation with no discardable hand card, permitting the Special Summon while the mandatory 'then discard 1 card' could not be performed.
